exposure: CD with prior perianal surgery vs without surgery
UC with prior surgery vs without surgery
CD with prior intestinal surgery vs without surgery
Bowel surgery before pregnancy (categorized into 6 types)
cohort: Pregnancies in women with CD or UC from 1997 to 2022 (833 UC and 3,150 CD pregnancies with prior surgery, and 12,883 UC and 6,972 CD pregnancies without surgery)
finding: In women with CD or UC, prior bowel surgery was associated with an increased risk of cesarean section and certain perinatal complications, with specific risks varying by type of surgery and underlying disease.
mod_finding: Prior bowel surgery, particularly ileoanal pouch surgery for UC and intestinal surgery for CD, was associated with an increased risk of cesarean section.
